retrievalProfile.description: A dark, surrealist illustration featuring cybernetic or skeletal guard dogs in front of a brooding gothic building with glowing windows.
triggerTerms: red neon script over dark illustration

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic scene depicting three monstrous, cybernetic dogs with exposed ribcages and metallic plating, positioned in the foreground of a dark, symmetrical stone building under a stormy sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Aggressive foreground subjects contrasting with a static architectural background
Warm yellow window light piercing a cool grey and brown environment
Vibrant red typography layered over dark, textured clouds
Diagonal movement of the central creature leading the eye from bottom-left to center
coreInvariants: Skeletal or cybernetic ribcage detailing on the primary subject
Spiked red collars on all creatures
Symmetrical gothic building with exactly three visible glowing windows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three large creatures dominate the lower two-thirds of the frame in a staggered, overlapping formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white-ribbed creature acts as the primary focal point due to its high value contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red text in the top left, follows the diagonal line of the dogs' bodies down to the right, and returns to the glowing windows of the house.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured ground and stormy sky provide breathing room for the complex, detailed subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones, including charcoal grey, muddy brown, and slate blue.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the interior window glow and white for the skeletal highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated crimson red used for typography and collars.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment allows the high-saturation red and high-value yellow to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a dark, moody spectrum

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and expressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Blocky, geometric sans-serif with tight kerning
Bottom line: Dynamic, slanted brush script with a glowing outer halo
Consistent 45-degree upward tilt for the script line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'D' in the script have elongated, whip-like flourishes
Letters in the script are connected by fluid, energetic strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, industrial block letters and fluid, organic hand-drawn script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow for legibility against dark clouds

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky feel of the top line
Provides the base skeleton for the energetic bottom line

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, airbrushed illustration of three cybernetic dogs with metallic ribs and red spiked collars standing on a dark ground in front of a gothic stone house with glowing yellow windows under a stormy grey sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold red sans-serif text in the top left. Below it, add a slanted, white-and-red brush script with a vibrant red neon outer glow.

verificationChecks: Do the windows have a warm yellow glow?
Are the dogs' ribs clearly defined and metallic?
Is the red text high-contrast against the sky?

adjustableVariables: Degree of mechanical vs. organic detail on the dogs
Thickness of the neon glow on the script
mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific existing band names or logos
Ensure the house architecture is generic gothic rather than a specific landmark
postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct dog heads
Verify the red collars have metallic spikes
Ensure the text does not obscure the main creature's face
Confirm the sky has a turbulent, painterly texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Gothic Surrealism + Cybernetic Creatures + Neon Rock Typography
